label: Pete Hegseth
narrative: Hegseth is the named releasing authority for every PURSUE tranche. On 20 February 2026, hours after Trump's Truth Social post directing him to begin identifying and releasing UAP files, Hegseth answered publicly with a screenshot and emoji rather than a policy statement; on 25 February he told reporters the Department would be 'in full compliance with that executive order, [and we're] eager to provide that for the president,' while hedging on schedule - 'I don't want to over-promise and under-deliver. So, we're going to take a little time to make sure we assess what this should look like.' He also committed the Department to work 'closely with the Office of the Director of National Intelligence' on implementation, which is why ODNI-numbered documents appear inside a war.gov release series. His published statement on the PURSUE portal is that the Department is 'in lockstep with President Trump to bring unprecedented transparency regarding our government's understanding of Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena.' Between 8 May and 7 August 2026 his department published five tranches - roughly 400-plus files including well over a hundred sensor videos - through a portal that is not AARO's. That routing is the substantive fact about Hegseth in this domain: the material went out over the head of the statutory UAP office, from the Secretary's own web estate, with an explicit departmental refusal to characterise any of it. Asked directly whether extraterrestrial life exists, he said: 'We'll see... I get to do the review and find out along with you.'
